name: comments, blank lines, indents, tabs
text:
# a carol

  %bpm 90
	%rest 2
   
la	C4:1   D4:0.5+E4:0.5
# between
lee G4:2

name: the whole song's lines
text:
%bpm 84
%together
%diction spoken
%diction ER held>=240 -> AH ~ER
were G4:4

name: a rest and a lane before the tempo
lanes with their words, and after the last
text:
%bpm 90
%vibrato 0
%rest 2
la C4:1
%vibrato 1:2
lee G4:2
%vibrato 0
%rest 1
%vibrato 0.5 2:3
%rest 1
la A4:0.75
%vibrato 0.3
%rest 1

name: the instructions' words sung
text:
%bpm 90
rest E4:1
bpm E4:1
vibrato C4:1 D4:1 E4:1
together C4:1 D4:1 E4:1
diction C4:1 D4:1
Rest D4:2

name: rests in a row and a tail
a number and odd words
text:
%bpm 90
3 C4:1
o'er D4:1 E4:1
la, C4:1
twenty-one C4:1 D4:1 E4:1

name: old bpm
refused: line 1: 90: a note is NOTE:BEATS (the instruction is written %bpm 90)

name: old rest
refused: line 3: 0.5: a note is NOTE:BEATS (the instruction is written %rest 0.5)

name: old together
refused: line 2: together: a word takes its notes, NOTE:BEATS each (the instruction is written %together)

name: old diction
refused: line 2: spoken: a note is NOTE:BEATS (the instruction is written %diction spoken)

name: old vibrato
refused: line 2: 0: a note is NOTE:BEATS (the instruction is written %vibrato 0 1:2)

name: old bare vibrato
refused: line 2: vibrato: a word takes its notes, NOTE:BEATS each (the instruction is written %vibrato)

name: bpm after a word
refused: line 2: %bpm is the whole song's: it comes before the first word

name: diction after a word
refused: line 3: %diction is the whole song's: it comes before the first word

name: together after a word
refused: line 3: %together is the whole song's: it comes before the first word

name: bpm twice
refused: line 2: %bpm given twice: a song has one tempo

name: bpm 0
refused: line 1: %bpm 0: 20 to 400 beats a minute

name: bpm too slow
refused: line 1: %bpm 19.9: 20 to 400 beats a minute

name: bpm too fast
refused: line 1: %bpm 100000: 20 to 400 beats a minute

name: bpm not a number
refused: line 1: %bpm fast: 20 to 400 beats a minute

name: bpm nan
refused: line 1: %bpm nan: 20 to 400 beats a minute

name: bpm with more
refused: line 1: %bpm takes one number

name: bare %bpm
refused: line 1: %bpm takes one number

name: bare %rest
refused: line 2: %rest takes one number, its beats

name: rest 0
refused: line 2: 0: beats must be a positive number

name: rest negative
refused: line 2: -1: beats must be a positive number

name: rest inf
refused: line 2: inf: beats must be a positive number

name: rest hex
refused: line 2: 0x10: beats must be a positive number

name: rest two numbers
refused: line 2: %rest takes one number, its beats

name: together with more
refused: line 2: %together takes nothing after it

name: together twice
refused: line 3: %together given twice

name: bare %diction
refused: line 2: %diction takes a rule (diction.rs), or spoken, or sung

name: bare %vibrato
refused: line 2: %vibrato takes its sizes, VALUE or VALUE:BEATS each

name: vibrato a note
refused: line 2: C4:1: a size is VALUE or VALUE:BEATS, the value 0 or more

name: vibrato negative
refused: line 2: -1: a size is VALUE or VALUE:BEATS, the value 0 or more

name: vibrato over nothing
refused: line 2: : beats must be a positive number

name: vibrato over 0
refused: line 2: 0: beats must be a positive number

name: vibrato two colons
refused: line 2: 2:3: beats must be a positive number

name: not an instruction
refused: line 2: %tempo: not an instruction (%bpm, %together, %diction, %rest, %vibrato)

name: an instruction in capitals
refused: line 1: %BPM: not an instruction (%bpm, %together, %diction, %rest, %vibrato)

name: a bare %
refused: line 2: %: not an instruction (%bpm, %together, %diction, %rest, %vibrato)

name: a word alone
refused: line 2: la: a word takes its notes, NOTE:BEATS each

name: a note with two colons
refused: line 2: C4:1:2: a note is NOTE:BEATS

name: a note with no beats
refused: line 2: C4: a note is NOTE:BEATS

name: a note with no name
refused: line 2: :1: a note is NOTE:BEATS

name: a note of 0 beats
refused: line 2: 0: beats must be a positive number

name: two words on a line
refused: line 2: la: a note is NOTE:BEATS

name: a comment after a line
refused: line 2: #: a note is NOTE:BEATS

name: a note in small letters
refused: line 2: c4: not a note (C4, F#3, Bb2 or a MIDI number)

name: a note out of range
refused: line 2: C10: outside MIDI 0 to 127

name: a midi number out of range
refused: line 2: 128: MIDI 0 to 127

name: a note of no octave
refused: line 2: C: not a note (C4, F#3, Bb2 or a MIDI number)

name: an empty join
refused: line 2: : a note is NOTE:BEATS

name: empty braces
refused: line 2: la{}: a word's phones are written in one piece, commas between: night{N,AA,~AY:200,T}

name: braces not closed
refused: line 2: la{N,AA: a word's phones are written in one piece, commas between: night{N,AA,~AY:200,T}

name: braces alone
refused: line 2: {N,AA}: a word's phones are written in one piece, commas between: night{N,AA,~AY:200,T}

name: no bpm
refused: the song has no %bpm line

name: no words
refused: the song has no words

name: nothing
refused: the song has no %bpm line
